note: P60 cross-domain clinical pattern library. Used ONLY in the literature-based synthetic demonstration (synthetic provenance + provisional literature mode). Concept membership is by EXACT identity + unit taken from the cardiovascular handbook catalog (cv-*) or the activated MITO_DEMO_2026 synthetic demo catalog (demo:ubt-*); every member is re-verified by tests/domain/p60-clinical-patterns.test.ts. Thresholds are quoted from the cited sources; nothing here is a NASA flight rule, a Researcher-approved criterion or a diagnosis. Patterns never change a result's clinical class and never convert units.

excludedIdentities.reason: Catalog unit is 'mg/L FEU ή DDU' (two alternative unit systems); not one exact unit, so no D-dimer threshold can bind it.
Catalog concept 'BNP / NT-proBNP' combines two different peptides with different cut-offs; ambiguous.

news2.note: Single-parameter bands only. An aggregate NEWS2 score is never calculated: consciousness level and supplemental oxygen are not recorded and same-time measurement is not established. SpO2 uses Scale 1 (the default for adults without documented hypercapnic respiratory failure).

crpInflammation.text: CRP above 10 mg/L: repeat the test and look for a source of infection or inflammation (CDC/AHA).

lactate.text: Serum lactate above 2 mmol/L is one element of the Sepsis-3 septic-shock definition (together with vasopressor need, not recorded here); lactate also rises with exercise, sampling delay and other causes.

ddimer.text: Above the conventional 0.5 mg/L FEU cut-off used by many assays; cut-offs are assay-specific and age-adjusted above 50 years (ESC 2019). Age is not recorded.

ee.text: Average E/e′ above 14 is one of the ASE/EACVI criteria for raised left-ventricular filling pressure; septal vs lateral vs average is not recorded.

cardiacConvergence.text: Cardiac findings converge for PP-2 only when LVEF is 40 % or lower, or E/e′ above 14 coincides with NT-proBNP at or above the acute-setting threshold (300 pg/mL). Otherwise MONITORING.

priorityRules.text: A vital-sign value lies in a NEWS2 single-parameter 3-point band (RCP 2017). NEWS2 bands have no measurement precondition that could lower the score; unrecorded oxygen therapy or consciousness could only raise it.

Two independent findings converge on the same concern on the same or adjacent dates (for example fever with CRP above 10 mg/L; QTc above 500 ms with potassium below 3.5 mmol/L; D-dimer above the cut-off with SpO2 or respiratory rate in a NEWS2 ≥2-point band). Convergence is required because each single finding has an unrecorded condition (assay, correction formula, fasting, timing).

A sodium change larger than the 10 mmol/L-per-24-hours limit between two observations at most one day apart, with provisional abnormal values at both ends. Also carries a DATA CHECK because a change of this size without documented treatment first requires sample and analyser verification.
A single literature threshold is met without convergence, or a contributing result is AMBER (provisional) or carries a review-priority change.
Every contributing result is held for measurement verification, so no clinical statement is made until it is repeated.
